package.name: aav_smoother
package.description: Our own velocity smoother in Rust (rclrs), for a car: Nav2's velocity_smoother's speed limits, timeout, deadband and feedback, with the turn rate from where the wheels can be (the steering actuator's rate, full lock). A trial in Nav2's velocity_smoother's place (navigation.launch.py smoother:=own): the same node name, parameters and topics.
